title: New Worlds: We are living in the future of J.G. Ballard or William Gibson
summary: A cultural commentary comparing contemporary technological and societal trends to the speculative futures depicted by influential sci-fi authors J.G. Ballard and William Gibson, exploring how their prophetic visions have materialized in our current world.
problem_solved: Provides cultural and philosophical perspective on how science fiction predictions have shaped or predicted modern reality.
why_valuable: Offers intellectual insight into the cultural impact of speculative fiction and its relevance to understanding contemporary technological society.
